title: One Representation to Rule Them All -- Open-Vocabulary Change Detection from Text or Visual Examples
abstract: arXiv:2611.34430v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-vocabulary change detection (OVCD) aims to localise user-specified changes without retraining for predefined categories. Existing approaches typically rely on textual descriptions and combine separate models for region proposal, semantic recognition, and temporal comparison. This limits how target concepts can be expressed and makes detection dependent on several intermediate predictions. We introduce OVTSID3, a training-free framework that unifies region grouping, concept identification, and temporal comparison in the representation space of DINOv3. OVTSID3 supports two complementary modes of concept specification: zero-shot textual queries or one-shot visual prompting through a masked reference pair. OVTSID3 outperforms all prior training-free OVCD methods on two building and two natural-disaster benchmarks, raising the average F1 by 8.9 points. OVTSID3 also supports semantic change detection and achieves state-of-the-art on SEC

translated_title: 一个表示统治一切——基于文本或视觉示例的开放词汇变化检测
translated_abstract: 开放词汇变化检测（OVCD）旨在无需为预定义类别重新训练的情况下定位用户指定的变化。现有方法通常依赖文本描述，并组合用于区域提议、语义识别和时间比较的多个独立模型。这限制了目标概念的表达方式，并使检测依赖于多个中间预测。我们提出了OVTSID3，这是一个免训练框架，它在DINOv3的表示空间中统一了区域分组、概念识别和时间比较。OVTSID3支持两种互补的概念指定模式：零样本文本查询或通过掩码参考对进行的单样本视觉提示。OVTSID3在两个建筑和两个自然灾害基准上优于所有先前的免训练OVCD方法，将平均F1提高了8.9个百分点。OVTSID3还支持语义变化检测，并在SEC上取得了最先进的结果。
tldr: 提出免训练框架OVTSID3，在DINOv3表示空间中统一区域分组、概念识别与时间比较，支持文本或视觉示例两种方式指定变化目标，使开放词汇变化检测的平均F1较现有免训练方法提升8.9个百分点。
en_tdlr: OVTSID3 is a training-free framework that unifies region grouping, concept identification, and temporal comparison within DINOv3's representation space, supporting both textual and visual concept specification to improve average F1 by 8.9 points over prior training-free open-vocabulary change detection methods.
